sections.label: Rail reliability update request
sections.summary: A Member asked the Minister for Transport for an update on rail reliability and how efforts will be sustained and funded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport whether he can provide an update on the current level of our rail reliability and how such continued efforts are going to be sustained and funded.

sections.label: MRT MKBF achievement
sections.summary: In the 12 months ending June 2019, the MRT network achieved an MKBF of more than 950,000 train-km.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: In the 12 months ending in June 2019, the MRT network achieved an MKBF of more than 950,000 train-km – almost one million train-km.

sections.label: SMRT Trains financial loss
sections.summary: In the latest reported financial year, SMRT Trains incurred a loss of $86 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: In the latest reported financial year, Singapore MRT (SMRT) Trains incurred a loss of $86 million.

sections.label: Government operating subsidies spending
sections.summary: Over the next five years, the Government expects to spend $4.5 billion on operating subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Over the next five years, the Government expects to spend $4.5 billion on operating subsidies.

sections.label: Sustaining rail efforts and fares
sections.summary: The Government will provide a temporary enhanced maintenance grant, and sustaining efforts requires operator investment in maintenance and regular fare adjustments, with fare review entrusted to the PTC.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, the Government will provide the operators with a temporary enhanced maintenance grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: But we have to sustain these efforts over the long term in order to prevent problems from gradually building up again.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: This requires discipline: on the operating side to ensure that LTA and the operators invest in upgrades and preventive maintenance of the rail system long before problems become apparent and serious and, on the commuter side, to implement regular fare adjustments to keep the rail system financially viable and Government subsidies under control, so that we can sustain a high quality and affordable public transport network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We have entrusted the important task of fare review to the PTC and they will be fair to commuters, taxpayers and operators.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: I seek the Members’ full support for the PTC as and when they make recommendations on transport fare adjustments.

sections.label: Engineer on MKBF targets
sections.summary: An engineer said that after one million MKBF, we can always try for two, three or four million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As an engineer, we know that after one million MKBF, we can always try for two million, three million, four million.

sections.label: Rail reliability target MKBF
sections.summary: The target is one million MKBF, a level only a handful of metros consistently achieve and which is a very good, reliable service level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: And the same thing with rail reliability, at one million MKBF which is what we have targeted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We had surveyed the performance of metros around the world and only a handful consistently achieved a million or crossed a million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: And a million, in fact, is a very good, reliable level of service.

sections.label: Targeted rail operating subsidy proportion
sections.summary: The passage asks what the targeted proportion of Government subsidy for rail operating cost is in the longer run.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The first is what is the targeted proportion of Government subsidy for rail operating cost in the longer run?

sections.label: Government infrastructure and operating assets funding
sections.summary: Government was to pay for infrastructure and first operating assets, with later operations from fare and non-fare revenue, giving zero operating subsidy, but now it is more than 30%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The intention was that the Government will pay for the infrastructure, that means, the tracks, the viaducts, the underground tunnels, plus the first set of operating assets, which include the trains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Subsequent train operations, which include future replacement of the operating assets, have to be paid for from the fare revenue plus non-fare revenues, which include advertising.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: And if we achieve that, then the operating subsidy would have been zero.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But now, it is more like more than 30%.

sections.label: Lines above one million MKBF
sections.summary: Three of five lines are already above a million MKBF, and the other two, including the East-West Line, are not too far behind.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Out of five lines, three are already above a million, and the other two, which include the East-West Line, are not too far behind.

sections.label: Operating subsidy percentage must not rise
sections.summary: The operating subsidy percentage must not continue to rise, as deteriorating from 0% to 30% and beyond would be a bad outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The key point is we must not allow the operating subsidy percentage to continue to rise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: If from 0%, it now deteriorates to 30% and continues to deteriorate, I think that would be a bad outcome.

sections.label: MKBF seven-fold increase since 2016
sections.summary: The speaker was cautious about solving the problem within four to five years, but today there is a seven-fold increase in MKBF compared to 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: I know the problem would be solved but I was cautious as to whether it could be solved within four to five years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: I think today, compared to 2016, it was a seven-fold increase in MKBF.

sections.label: 800,000 target global metro data
sections.summary: The 800,000 figure was set after reviewing global data of other metros and was considered doable during this term of Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That was set after looking at the global data of the other metros.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I thought 800,000 was something doable, during this term of Government.
